title: Discover the mechanism and stereochemical preference of a CBSCA-catalyzed isochroman synthesis
difficulty_reasons: The mechanism is not supplied, so materially distinct ionization, binding, bond-forming and proton-transfer hypotheses must be generated before stereochemical conformer and transition-state searches.
The final claim requires validated R/S pathways, hypothesis discrimination, common-reference thermochemistry and an explicit coverage/stopping argument.
